Definition: to leave a place or person permanently
Example: He had to abandon his car in the snow.

Definition: the skill or power to do something
Example: She has the ability to learn languages quickly.

Definition: the state of being away from somewhere
Example: His absence from class worried the teacher.

Definition: to take in a substance through a surface
Example: Plants absorb sunlight to make food.

Definition: existing in thought but not as a physical object

Example: Fish are abundant in this river.
She has a strong academic record.

Definition: to succeed in doing something difficult
Example: He accomplished his goal of running a marathon.
The report must be accurate and complete.

Definition: to succeed in reaching a goal
Example: You can achieve anything with hard work.
